concepts.SCRIPTful_PRODUCT_in_this_repo: MBM website/variant SKU export layer (docs/scriptful-variant-skus.md, scripts/gen-scriptful-variant-skus.ts) — NOT a GEN API object observed in Client Products payloads.
concepts.GEN_CLIENT_PRODUCT: Objects returned by GET /v2/client/products (productId / clientProductId / displayName / pricing / pharmacies…). This is what website routing locks to.
concepts.FORMULARY_MEDICATION: Pharmacy formulary rows identified by medicationId + standardizedMedicationName + pharmacyName.
concepts.CLIENT_PRODUCT_MEDICATION_PAIRING: Links exposed read-only via ?view=formulary as formularyProducts[] rows keyed by productId. Write path NOT available via Client Products API (GEN-CATALOG-2A / GEN_LIVE_FORMULARY_PAIRING_AUDIT); admin UI required for attach/detach.

data_model.relationship_supported_by_evidence: Website variant → locked genClientProductId (Client Product) → zero or more formulary medication pairings (readable via formulary view). No Scriptful product id fields appear on Client Product payloads.
data_model.when_owner_edits_explanation: If the owner attaches/detaches formulary medications on a GEN Client Product in the Products admin UI, those pairings are the same objects returned by GET /v2/client/products?view=formulary. Our audit already successfully reads pairings for other CPs (71 formulary rows / 23 products with attachments). Therefore successful Client-Product formulary edits SHOULD appear in the current audit endpoint.
caveats: If “Scriptful Products” refers to a different GEN UI surface than Client Product formulary pairing, we have NO separate API evidence for that layer → cannot confirm visibility (would be UNKNOWN for that hypothetical path).
Inactive Client Products drop from the default list per AGENTS.md — not visible in this inventory.
No Scriptful identifiers are exposed on Client Product JSON keys observed in live responses.
data_model.same_data_layer_explanation: In-repo “Scriptful” = website SKU system. Owner phrase “Scriptful / GEN Products” likely means GEN Products admin. GEN API evidence only shows Client Products + formularyProducts. No distinct Scriptful Product resource found in live payloads. If owner edits are Client Product formulary pairings, they are the audited layer (YES for that interpretation).
data_model.does_api_prove_explanation: API does not prove a failed save. Multiple intended medications are visible on DIFFERENT Client Products than the website-locked IDs (Minoxidil→Raw7m, TIR B12/Glycine→GLP-2 Any Dose, Wolverine capsule med→Injection CP). That pattern fits wrong-target edits or duplicate-product confusion better than “edits vanished.”
